title: 工银国际程实：人民币升值有空间，但央行更需提振内需
speaker: Xiaojiu

segments.en: Do they make sense to you? I think if we look at the midterm fundamentals, I think CNY really has a more room to gain.
segments.zh: 您认为这些说法合理吗？从中期基本面看，人民币确实还有升值空间。

segments.en: but if we look at China's weak domestic and its continued very muted relation, and also this very apparent yield gap against the US,
segments.zh: 但考虑到国内需求偏弱、通胀低迷，以及中美利差明显倒挂，

segments.en: certainly I think the PBOC and Chinese authorities will allow this continued appreciation of the CNY to, but in the meantime they need to also accommodate the adjustment,
segments.zh: 央行和相关部门会允许人民币继续升值，但同时也需要应对调整。

segments.en: because ultimately, I don't think the PBOC has deliberately to keep CNY at a very low level.
segments.zh: 因为央行并非刻意压低人民币汇率。

segments.en: They need to do more in terms of how they can really boost domestic demand rather than through the adjustment of CNY.
segments.zh: 他们更需要着力提振内需，而不是依赖汇率调整。
